about.quote: A good app is one you use without thinking about it.
about.heading: About
about.lead: A web developer since 2015, I live in the Cotentin, by the sea.
about.p1: Trained in computer science (a DUT in Caen), then in web design (a professional degree), I’ve stayed between the two: I design what I code, and I code what I design. Since 2018 I’ve been building accounting applications for oil groups at CICD.
about.p2: Alongside that, I take on short freelance missions in the evenings and at weekends, remotely: a website, a business tool, an app that needs to grow.
about.p3: The rest of the time I’m in the water, surfing or paddleboarding depending on the sea, or working on a game: Kaplouf comes from my taste for game design.
about.skills_text: What I use day to day. On an existing project, I work with the stack already in place.

contact.heading: Got a project in mind? Let’s talk.
contact.text: A website, a business tool, an app that needs to grow: send me a few lines about what you need, and I’ll reply with concrete questions and a first idea.
contact.availability: Short freelance missions, evenings and weekends, remote, alongside my job at CICD.
contact.f_note: No server in between: your mail app opens with the message ready to go.
contact.f_sent: Your mail app opens with the message ready to go. Nothing opened? Write to {email}.

footer.colophon: Made with Nuxt. Set in Anybody, Instrument Sans and IBM Plex Mono, plus each project’s own typefaces. Screenshots taken from the real apps; the side projects show demo data.
